rootCauseHypotheses: CONFIRMED CODE BUG: The board.py filter uses WHERE date(last_seen_at)=today, which is too aggressive. Even with window_days=30 set by the user in the UI, repos are invisible unless fetch ran *today*. The fix should replace the today-gate with a window_days-based cutoff (last_seen_at >= now - window_days).
Fetch timer (github-digest-fetch.timer) last ran 2026-02-21 12:00 UTC; next run is 2026-02-22 08:00 UTC. Until then, the today-gate blocks all 62 repos regardless of window_days setting.

Radar /today empty: daily_picks has 7 rows for 2026-02-21 but /api/today queries date('now')=2026-02-22. Radar pipeline (ingest-hn, rank-daily) has no scheduled job — must be run manually or added to cron.
github-digest-summarize.timer also exists (last ran 04:00 UTC today) but no radar pipeline timer exists.

schedulerFix.recommendedFix: 1. Merge or deploy github_radar branch. 2. Create github-digest-radar.service + github-digest-radar.timer (OnCalendar=*-*-* 09:00:00, one hour after fetch). 3. systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now github-digest-radar.timer
schedulerFix.schedulerRootCause: GitHub Radar pipeline (ingest-hn, rank-daily, etc.) lives on 'github_radar' branch only. No systemd unit or crontab exists for it. The installed systemd units only cover fetch and summarize on main branch.
schedulerFix.suggestedCrontab:
# Daily fetch (08:00 UTC)
0 8 * * * cd /opt/github-digest && flock -n /tmp/gd-fetch.lock .venv/bin/github-digest fetch >> /var/log/github-digest/fetch.log 2>&1
# Radar pipeline (09:00 UTC, after fetch)
0 9 * * * cd /opt/github-digest && flock -n /tmp/gd-radar.lock .venv/bin/python3 run_daily_pipeline.py --skip-github >> /var/log/github-digest/radar.log 2>&1
